name: rust-engineering
description: Automatic Rust engineering orchestration with 46 focused skills, a 265-rule coding rulebook, and an adapted Actionbook cognitive protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Route Rust work through focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Starts with a fast read-only Rust context hook, then routes implementation through one primary and at most two supporting engineering profiles. A progressive-disclosure overlay selects up to eight relevant rules from 265 addressable Rust coding rules. The adapted Actionbook protocol adds cross-layer design, current research, Cargo-metadata dossiers, navigation, and a conditional 47-rule unsafe and FFI review corpus without adding automatic heavy hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $rust-workflow to route this Rust change, apply relevant $rust-coding-rules, implement it, and verify the result.
